scene noonsky
There’s someone I want to see.
Someone I’ve been mostly neglecting since waking up from my makeshift coma.
It’s someone who always manages to take the pain away, replacing it with an ever-growing darkness that, strangely enough, makes me feel like I’m home.
Maybe it’s because the darkness she fills me with blends in nicely with the kind I’ve created myself but, regardless-
There’s someone I want to see.
scene buddybug
There’s someone I want to see.
She’s someone who should not exist, but she does anyway.
She’s someone who eats rumors and turns their tiny bones to special lines we can make ladders with.
She sleeps in a box in a place beneath the subway and masturbates furiously to the sounds a stepson makes.
I want to hold her hand and see if I can find any pink or black hairs. The smell of propane. That dim, auburn glow.
We met one another inside of a beaker.
She spat in my mouth and made me eat last week’s supper.
I often think about ripping her hair out and stapling it onto the scalp of someone who needs it more.
Can you hear this, Kyoko?
Your daughter is a nightmare.
She has my eyes.
scene noonsky
Ignore that.
Anyway, there’s someone I want to see.
Her name is Nodoka Nagasawa, and I’m going to fuck her mouth until her teeth fall out.
scene black
scene otohanodokalibrary1
When I make it to the library, I find that Nodoka is accompanied by someone rather strange today.
Well...not strange in the sense that these two aren’t often seen together. But the sense where Otoha doesn’t typically- ah, fuck it. You know what I mean.
Either way, both of them are here — which means there will be no mouth-fucking unless Otoha’s looking to broaden her horizons so wide that I can sort of just sneak my way into her sex-life.
That would be neat. She has nice legs. They both do.
: You guys have nice legs.
scene otohanodokalibrary2
scene otohanodokalibrary1
: Thanks.
: No problem, Otoha. Just here to provide some encouragement so you two can study more effectively.
scene otohanodokalibrary3
: Wait, yeah. What are you doing here?
: I just told you.
: No, I mean like...I thought you were trying to stay away from this place? Does this mean you’re coming back to school now?
: Absolutely not. I’m here to see Nodoka.
scene otohanodokalibrary4
: I’m Nodoka.
: Are you free right now?
: That depends. Is this your way of subtly asking me to have sex with you without directly revealing the nature of our extremely passionate relationship to my roommate?
: Your words, not mine.
: Not to mention your roommate already knows about your “extremely passionate relationship.” I heard it loud and clear, remember?
scene otohanodokalibrary5
: Oh, right. I took quite a beating that night and must only now be experiencing the adverse effects of having my head pressed up against the wall for so long.
: No. I think you’re just being a douche.
scene otohanodokalibrary6
: Perhaps. I think the more likely explanation, though, is that I’m just a bit preoccupied at the moment. My mind can only handle so much at once, you know.
: That’s news to me.

: Nodoka’s been caught up in some weird research loop lately. And I’m pretty sure it’s about you, so if you could just spill your heart out to her or whatever, it might save all of us some time and trouble.
: I’m afraid there’s nothing Akira could tell me that would aid in my research, but yes. That is a thing I am currently doing. Which means I must regretfully deny your invitation to “Pound Town.”
: I can be quick.
: Wow. You’re really just shameless now, aren’t you?
: If it’s quick, I’m sure Otoha can handle it. She might ask you to call her “Onee-chan,” though.
scene otohanodokalibrary7
: Hah...
: Alright, Otoha. Let’s do this. We don’t have to look at each other if you don’t want to.
scene otohanodokalibrary8
: Come on, man. I’ve actually kind of missed you. Please don’t go making things weird just a few seconds into our reunion.
: Hey, get mad at Nodoka, not me. She’s the one who volunteered you. And she works here, so I was under the impression her word was law.
: Akira, I know your brain’s all scrambled and shit right now, but I’d like to remind you that this is a library, not a brothel.
: A library is just a brothel for knowledge.
scene otohanodokalibrary9
: He raises a fair point.
: No he doesn’t! And even if he did, wouldn’t that imply I can just, like...educate him?!
: Stop yelling in the knowledge brothel. It’s against the rules.
: Can you put a leash on your pet, please?
: That’s the whole reason I came here and now it’s starting to sound like I’m going to have to fuck a book.
scene otohanodokalibrary10
: Well, fuck whatever you want so long as it’s not me. I have work to do, and it’s imperative that I finish this section before I lose my train of thought.
: I have work to do too, you know? I’ve been working on this song non-stop and it’s still all...not good and shit.
: Then perhaps you can find inspiration in the arms of an older man? That’s what Tchaikovsky would have done.
: I don’t know how to play piano, but I can assure you I am still very good with my-
scene otohanodokalibrary11
: Do not, under any circumstance, finish that sentence.
: If you’re okay with just hanging out and talking, I’ll take a break with you for a little while. And, before you ask, no. “Hanging out and talking” is not Zoomer slang for hooking up.
: You actually want to hang out with me?
: When has what I want to do ever mattered to you before? Your favorite pastime is barging into my room and pretending to watch porn while I’m on the phone with my parents.
: True. But don’t let my infallible comedic senses fool you, Otoha. I’m just a step or two away from breaking into a million pieces right now and things could get pretty messy really quickly.
: Then please go elsewhere now as I do not want little bits of Akira all over my notebook. That is what my face is for.
: Come on, Sensei. Let’s let the genius do her research.
scene black
Otoha gets up from the table and closes her notebook, throwing it on top of a stack of about ten others as I’m reminded that Nodoka isn’t the only imperfect perfectionist around.

As we make our way to the opposite end of the library, I can’t help but worry that the man I’ve become will make the wrong impression on Otoha and taint the sapling of a relationship we’ve formed so far.
scene yuminightfrog1
scene black
But then I remember Yumi.
And I remember that she and I barely have a relationship at all.
And that this broken part of me somehow brought her closer.
Has that been the key all along?
Do these stupid, unknowing teenagers eat up vulnerability the same way I do?
Are they trying to take advantage of me now?
Does Otoha want my COCK?
Does she want my BIG, THROBBING COCK?
scene otohanodokalibrary12
No.
No she doesn’t.
And I need to calm down.
I need to remember where I am and who I am.
What pieces I have left and the ones I need to find.
And none of them are inside of her.
: So...how are you holding up?
But I suppose if they are, I can just pull them out of her stomach once she’s sleeping.
scene otohanodokalibrary13
: I almost jumped off a bridge the other day. That was fun.
scene otohanodokalibrary14
: You...what?
: I don’t know if I should say it again based on that expression.
: Are you a fucking idiot? Why would you do that?
: I don’t know. It kind of just happened.
: I’m pretty much just running on auto-pilot now. I don’t really have anything left to lose.
: You have fucking tons to lose, man. I know a handful of girls who’d straight up just crumble if anything bad ever happened to you. Just think of Niki.
: I’ve been trying not to.
: Why? She loves you.
: That’s why.
scene otohanodokalibrary15
: Niki’s too good to be true.
: And not only do I not deserve her, but she confuses me. Or maybe I just don’t actually want to feel better. I don’t know.
: That’s why I’m here to see Nodoka. I get her.
: Nobody gets Nodoka, Sensei.
: I just mean I “get” what our relationship is.
: I can hide inside of her when what I’m feeling becomes too much to bear.
: Can you not do that with Niki?
: I can. But what Nodoka takes away is different.
: Niki walks away with love when I’m done with her. All Nodoka gets is a chance to feel human for a little while. Or maybe, like...research or something. I don’t know.
: But whatever it is, it’s not love. Just a little escapism. And I think the only reason it works for the two of us is because we’re not great at feeling things the way other people are.
scene otohanodokalibrary16
: Well, call me crazy, but you seem more relatable than ever right now. And that’s because you’re feeling all this shit.
: I don’t want to be relatable. I just want to be complacent.
: I don’t need happiness or love or anything like that — just a moment or two of silence and a cute girl I can bury myself in when porn won’t do the trick anymore.
: I can’t...really tell if you’re just messing with me right now or if all of this is actually legit.
: What’s confusing you?
: Well, the fact that you’ve never been this open for one.
: Like I said, I have nothing to lose now.
: Yeah, but second thing is just...how fucking dumb all of this is.
: Dumb?
scene otohanodokalibrary17
: Just a moment or two of silence and a cute girl I can bury myself in when porn won’t do the trick anymore...
: No offense, but you sound like some twelve-year old edgelord who just got rejected by a girl for the first time ever.
scene otohanodokalibrary18
: Which...is fine. If that’s how you really feel. But I don’t think it is. I think you’re just...having trouble articulating what’s actually going on or...or something like that.
: I will admit that it’s been very long since I’ve attempted to properly articulate my feelings.
scene otohanodokalibrary19
: Then try that instead of wandering all the way across town to have sex with a teenager!
: You can make yourself feel better from the comfort of your own home without having to worry about accidentally plaguing the world with another Nodoka-spawn.
: Two Nodokas sounds horrible in terms of daily life. Sexually, though-
: I don’t need to hear about that part! Just stop being a downer and pull yourself together, dude. I’m sure you’ll find whatever it is that you apparently lost and, if you don’t-
scene otohanodokalibrary20
: There are a million other things out there that’ll fill the void once you stop crying.
: And if there aren’t?
: Then you’re probably holding yourself back on purpose.
: You good now, little bro?
: I forget how much I like you sometimes.
: You’d remember if I tried harder. I’m pretty good at minding my own business when I’m not destroying relationships and whatnot.
: You haven’t destroyed ours yet. I’m still hesitant to call you Onee-chan, though, given that you’re only half my age.
: Yeah, definitely...don’t do that. The “little bro” thing was just a joke. Nodoka’s only fucking around when she says all that stuff about me.
: I don’t know. Nodoka has accurately predicted the sexual behavior of at least one other person that I did not see coming, so I’m inclined to believe her intuition when it comes to this stuff.
: Please don’t.
scene otohanodokalibrary21
: If only I had experience being sexually attracted to people younger than me. Maybe then I would be able to understand your outlook on this.
: Really don’t.
scene otohanodokalibrary22
: You seem a little persistent, Otoha. Why?
: I just don’t want you to get distracted from the topic at hand. This is a conversation where I lend you a shoulder and you get some tears on it or something. It has nothing to do with me.
: Thankfully, your wise words have led to an immediate full recovery on my end. Thank you for saving my life, Otoha. Now, it is time to discuss your sexual preferences.
: Why do you always have to ruin literally everything?
: Isn’t that what little brothers do?
scene otohanodokalibrary23
: I mean...yeah. But you’re like six feet tall and-
: You’re blushing now. This really is a thing for you, huh?
scene otohanodokalibrary24
: No! It’s...I...
: I like somebody! A girl! Well...woman. So I clearly don’t-
: Niki, right?
: No, it’s-
scene otohanodokalibrary25
: Wait, how do you know that? What’d she tell you? How much do you know?
: Well, now I know that she knows. So that’s new information to me.
scene otohanodokalibrary26
: Oh, god damn it!
: It was your terrible beach confession speech that was very clearly not written for me that clued me in.
: And also the fact that she had a very abrupt non-answer on the phone when I told her about you and Rin breaking up.
scene otohanodokalibrary27
: But that speech was bullet-proof. How did you ever see through it?
: You wanted me to see through it even earlier, didn’t you?
: I may have been in desperate need of some advice in regard to whether or not this would ever be a plausible scenario for me.
scene otohanodokalibrary28
: But...I get now that it’s not. And that you probably wouldn’t give me any advice on how to hook up with your girlfriend anyway.
scene otohanodokalibrary29
: Or, shall I say- one of your girlfriends.
: This would be a good time to blackmail you if I was one of the bad guys.
: Do you want to both be bad guys for a second while I propose a trade?
scene otohanodokalibrary30
: You have my attention.
: I think we both have something that the other person wants.
: You give me Niki, I give you Nodoka? Deal. Take her. As far away as you can.
: I give you a picture of Niki...
: And you-
scene otohanodokalibrary31
: And I give you one of Rin!
: Bingo.
: Wow! This is really fucked up! I’m in!
: And I’m...
menu:
Just kidding
: ...not being serious. Sorry, Otoha.
scene otohanodokalibrary32
: Bruh...
: You’re really gonna do me like that?
: Yeah. I’ve screwed over enough people already. And even if I don’t have anything to lose, I don’t think I’m ready to stoop low enough to trade nudes of the girls I know like they’re currency.
scene otohanodokalibrary33
: Are you sure? I’ve got some pretty spicy ones, Akira. No one ever has to knooooow.
: Wow. You really want these, don’t you?
: My imagination can only take me so far.
: Aren’t you a writer?
scene otohanodokalibrary34
: For the sake of this conversation, let’s say...no. I am not.
: Let’s just...keep what’s in our phones to ourselves for now and...forget I ever made this proposition. Niki would kill me for even joking about it.
: And Rin-
scene otohanodokalibrary35
: Actually, I’m not sure how Rin would feel. She might be into it. But I was admittedly never in-tune with her feelings, soooo...maybe not.
: I say we just seize this rare opportunity to be good people and do that for once. Even if it leads to not experiencing things we would very much like to experience.
: I agree. Reluctantly, of course. But I agree.
scene black
: And I thank you for your time, but I must now go back to...not being a writer.
: And I must now go home and jerk off to nudes of a famous idol that you won’t ever see naked.
: You are the worst brother I’ve ever had.
I exit the library and...
I feel a little better.
Today was okay.

Sending it now
: Sending it right now.
scene otohanodokalibrary36
: Holy shit. This is fucked up even for you.
: Hey, you agreed to go along with it. You’re no better than I am.
: I still don't have your number th-
$ otohanumber = True
You have obtained Otoha Okakura's phone number!
: Well, that was way too easy.
: You're positive this is cool?
: We're in too deep now, aren't we? You gave me your phone number and everything. There's no turning back.
: Yeah, but I’m getting a picture of a famous idol I have no shot with and you’re getting a picture of some random high school girl who you’re probably going to fuck one day anyway.
: Fair point. Send me your nudes as well.
: Ew, no. You can have Rin and that’s it. My body is a temple and only one person is allowed to enter it at this moment in time.
: I bet that number would go up if I were twenty years younger.
: And I’m going to pretend you didn’t just say that. Are we doing this or not?
: We’re doing this. But no one can ever know.
: Got it.
: Seriously. I’m trusting you. Niki’s career could be in serious jeopardy if this gets into the wrong hands.
: I will not tell you what I am going to do with this picture, but I can confirm that it will definitely not be “destroying her career.”
: Promise?
: Yes. And if I go back on my word, I’ll let you do anything you want to me for ten whole minutes. That’s how serious I am.
: That’s barely enough time to do anything.
scene otohanodokalibrary37
: How much time do you need?!
: Twenty or I walk.
scene otohanodokalibrary38
: Deal.
: Pleasure doing business with you, Otoha.
: You as well, Akira. Now, please excuse me while I go somewhere private.
scene black
Otoha runs off to...probably the bathroom while Nodoka remains blissfully unaware about all that’s happening behind her.
Is this a terrible, disgusting idea? Probably. And it jeopardizes not one, but two of my closest relationships.
Like I said earlier, though...I have nothing to lose anymore.
So as I scroll through the pictures in my phone (That I had to restore from my computer after Ami deleted all of them), I sigh to myself, knowing that I’m a terrible person.
But that’s nothing new.
I’ve known it all along.
And the sudden beep of my phone is just the newest symbol of that.
I’m sorry, Rin.
I’m sorry, Niki.
